description: Start reading the facts out of evidence documents (DOCX, PDF, or files with a PDF rendition) into one list. Each document's current version is pinned. Every fact cites the passage it comes from, carries when it happened, whether it rests on a document or on testimony, and how unambiguous its meaning is; a fact whose meaning is genuinely contested is held with a note. An optional instruction says which facts matter. Returns a generation run id; poll lists.generations.list for its status and read the proposed facts with lists.generation-candidates.list, then accept or reject each.
